prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a high-fidelity desktop web application interface mockup, landscape 1536x1024. Server Monitor internal Hebrew RTL team password vault. This is a flat clean full screenshot, not a device photograph. User-approved composition: RIGHT 220px dark slate #192638 sidebar with Server Monitor wordmark and Hebrew navigation אתרים, לקוחות, כספת (selected), שרת ומשאבים, שירותים, הגדרות. Remaining content on cool porcelain #F2F5F9. Heebo Hebrew typography throughout, readable and precise. Compact heading כספת, top search field חיפוש אפליקציה, משתמש או כתובת, petrol #126B78 primary button פרטי גישה חדשים, subtle lock control נעילה. Central-right 360px white list pane with filters הכול / מועדפים. Five neat credential rows: Seder, LA webs, PDF Studio, Libi Diamonds, Manager Site. Selected Seder row with subtle pale petrol wash. LEFT broad white entry detail pane with heading Seder and small subtitle ניהול האפליקציה, visible labels שם משתמש and סיסמה. Fake username demo@example.test, password only •••••••••••• with accessible looking copy and reveal line icons. URL shown LTR https://lawebs.co.il/seder with primary action פתיחת אתר. Environment label ייצור and concise notes field. Outline star and edit controls. Roomy aligned field rows, functional 44px controls, restrained 12px corners, fine neutral separators. Text ink #1D2B3D. Small footer data label נתוני הדגמה. No illustrations, photography, glass, gradients, glow, giant headings or invented security claims. Exact Hebrew text if possible, orderly professional density. This mockup defines the approved list/detail layout and palette.
